title: Independently check #4580's p3 H-branch budget (322/397) with own certified powers; note two rounded bracket endpoints (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4580-budget-check/`, an independent arithmetic check of Matarener's #4580 (head `62545a03`): the p3 H-branch boundary budget at κ = 0.00302015. **All checked conclusions are confirmed. No new κ.** There is one small reporting note about rounded bracket endpoints.

Every moment is recomputed with this package's **own** certified powers `r^(1−s)` (atanh/exp series in exact rationals, outward on a `2^−256` grid). The sources' `h_interval` is never used. Only the signed profiles and H112 come from the same 16 pinned main sources.

## Checks

| | complex | BIT |
|---|---:|---:|
| raw surplus | 616 | 645 |
| budget at κ (budget + 1 certified negative) | **322** | **397** |
| direct bill fails at `s = 0` | 672 | 666 |
| own certified roots (bills 0 / one head / two heads) | .0063799044 / .0040422293 / .0017248833 | .0079333535 / .0051761597 / .0024471106 |

The native H112 has `rank(H − I) = 8`, full row and column support, and `H² = I` (own exact elimination). There are 112 and 111 distinct query lines.

**Reporting note.** Every printed `positive_at` is certified positive, and every printed `negative_at` lies within #4580's bisection width (about `3·10^−10`) of the root. But two printed `negative_at` values sit **just below** the root, where the moment is still positive:
- complex, bill 0: printed `0.0063799044`, root `0.00637990443…`;
- BIT, bill 222: printed `0.0051761597`, root `0.00517615973…`.

They are 10-decimal roundings, not certified brackets. The conclusions are unaffected.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4580-budget-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4580-budget-check outcome=completed   (~20 s, stdlib only)
```

**Limitations:**
- #4580 §4's decoder lower bound is a written argument; only its finite inputs are checked here.
- These are raw rank screens, as #4580 states.

Head: `fd9f28beff7d03464d5a07cbdb00c38f431a1613`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.

Credit: Matarener / Mark (#4580); zxv (#4359). Prepared by Ryanson Jonathan with substantial Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) assistance.
